description: List the services QConsul LLC offers and whether each can be booked through this MCP server. Read-only: it changes nothing and is safe to call repeatedly. Usage: call this first in any booking flow to get the service ids (standard-hourly, executive-subscription) that check_availability and prepare_booking accept. Returns the service catalog only, with no prices and no availability. For prices and the full published terms, use get_pricing_and_terms; for open times, use check_availability.
name: list_services

services.description: QConsul's services, each with its booking availability through this server.

bookableViaMcp.description: Whether this service can be booked through this MCP server.

id.description: Service id to pass to check_availability and prepare_booking.

note.description: Booking note for agents, where one applies.

price.description: Published price as display text, e.g. $425/hour.

total.description: Total charged per session as display text, e.g. $425.00.

title: List services
